description: This file defines the LoggerFactory class responsible for creating and managing Logger instances within the OrangeHRM application. It utilizes dependency injection and configuration settings to instantiate loggers with appropriate handlers.

classes.name: LoggerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving logger instances, ensuring singleton behavior per logger name.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a logger instance identified by name, configuring its handler with appropriate log level and file path.
